headline: Ginni Filaments announces special window for re-lodgement of physical share transfers
summary: Ginni Filaments Limited has informed the stock exchange about a special window for the re-lodgement of transfer of physical shares. This administrative process allows eligible shareholders to resubmit physical share transfer documents. The update is procedural in nature for holders of physical shares in the company. It has no material impact on the company's financial performance or listed stock price for retail investors.
why_it_matters: Procedural update only, no direct financial impact for retail investors.
